title: Tolkovo realtime: client → server message
description: One JSON text frame from a panel client, at most 1024 bytes. Mutations go over REST; the socket resumes the event stream and carries ephemeral signals: typing and who has a conversation open. resume is accepted once per connection, right after hello. At most 20 messages in a burst, then 2 per second. Anything else closes the connection with 1008.

resume.description: Replay the events of the workspace after last_seq that this connection may see, then resumed (or resync_required).

mode.description: What is being typed: reply (the customer will get it) or note (internal). Absent counts as note. Only a reply start is shown to the customer in a channel that can show typing (Telegram).

typing.description: The operator is typing in a conversation (start, repeated at most every 3 s while typing) or stopped. Needs conversations.reply or conversations.note, otherwise ignored. The server relays it to the workspace as conversation.typing and stores nothing; a reply start in a Telegram conversation also shows typing to the customer (needs conversations.reply).

viewing.description: The operator has the conversation open (start, repeated every 20 s while it stays open) or closed it (stop). One conversation per connection: start for another one replaces it. The server forgets a viewer 45 s after the last start or when the connection closes and relays the full list as conversation.viewers. Needs conversations.view, otherwise ignored.
